name: @pipeworx/mcp-hackernews

tools.name: search_hn
tools.description: Full-text search Hacker News via Algolia. Pass query plus optional tags filter (story, comment, ask_hn, show_hn; default: story). Returns title, URL, score, author, comment count, and timestamp.

tags.description: Content type filter: story, comment, ask_hn, or show_hn (default: story)

tools.name: get_top_stories
tools.description: Fetch the current live top-ranked Hacker News stories from the Firebase API. Returns up to `count` stories (default 10) with title, URL, score, author, comment count, and Unix timestamp.

count.description: Number of top stories to return (default: 10)

tools.name: get_stories
tools.description: Fetch Hacker News stories of a given TYPE: top (default), new (newest), best, ask (Ask HN), show (Show HN), or job (jobs/hiring). PREFER for "newest HN stories", "top Ask HN posts", "Show HN", "HN job postings / who is hiring". Returns title, URL (or self-text for Ask/Show), score, author, comment count, and timestamp.

type.description: Story list: top (default), new, best, ask, show, job.

count.description: Number of stories to return (default 10, max 100).

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Fetch a Hacker News story or comment by ID (e.g., "42153809"). Returns full text, score, author, timestamp, and child replies.

id.description: The numeric Hacker News item ID

tools.name: get_hn_comments
tools.description: Fetch the discussion (top-level comments, actual text) on a Hacker News story by its item ID. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "what are people saying about <HN story>", "HN discussion / developer sentiment on X". get_item returns only comment IDs; this resolves them to text. Find a story ID via get_top_stories or search_hn. Returns each top comment author, text, time, and reply count.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-hackernews forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the hackernews pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
